summary: VEON Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K press release announcing a new buyback of 72.5 million shares (3.9% of outstanding, 2.9 million ADSs, ~$200 million at $69.37/ADS on Sept 22, 2026), upgrading its May 2025 minimum $100 million annual target and following a completed $100 million program. The program includes open-market repurchases and proportional direct purchases from shareholder LetterOne (up to 32,957,830 shares). All acquired shares will be cancelled. Repurchases are underway, within VEON's broader securities repurchase parameters. Watch execution pace, LetterOne's residual stake, and any ADS overhang.
